chapters.summary_zh: 林岚回到海风港，发现老码头破败，决定修复它。
chapters.summary_en: Lan returns to Breezeport, finds the pier in ruins, and decides to restore it.

dialogue.speaker: lan
dialogue.en: This place... it's older than I remember.

dialogue.speaker: bo
dialogue.zh: 你外婆要是看见，准得骂人。
dialogue.en: Your grandma would've scolded everyone if she saw this.

dialogue.speaker: bo
dialogue.zh: 那块木板是你外婆亲手钉的。
dialogue.en: Your grandma nailed that plank herself.

dialogue.speaker: lan
dialogue.zh: 那我就照她的方法钉回去。
dialogue.en: Then I'll nail it back her way.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.zh: 终于有人肯回来了！喝茶，我请！
dialogue.en: Finally someone came back! Tea's on me!

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.zh: 对了，听说开发商派人来了……
dialogue.en: By the way, I hear the developer sent someone...

chapters.en: Chapter 2: The Man in the Suit
chapters.summary_zh: 程骏到来评估拆迁，林岚必须证明港口的价值。
chapters.summary_en: Jun arrives to assess demolition; Lan must prove the harbor is worth saving.

dialogue.speaker: nana
dialogue.zh: 我的店！真的是我的店吗？
dialogue.en: My shop! Is it really mine?

dialogue.speaker: lan
dialogue.en: You bring the bread, I bring the hammer.

dialogue.speaker: jun
dialogue.zh: 数据上，这里没有盈利可能。
dialogue.en: On paper, this place can't turn a profit.

dialogue.speaker: lan
dialogue.zh: 那你今天为什么排队买了娜娜的面包？
dialogue.en: Then why did you queue for Nana's bread today?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.zh: 程先生昨晚又去灯塔了，一个人。
dialogue.en: Mr. Cheng went to the lighthouse again last night. Alone.

chapters.summary_zh: 揭开阿博与程骏的往事，修好灯塔，港口迎来第一次夜市。
chapters.summary_en: Bo's and Jun's shared past comes out; the lighthouse is repaired and the harbor holds its first night market.

dialogue.speaker: bo
dialogue.zh: 二十年前那场风暴，是你父亲把我拉上了船。
dialogue.en: In the storm twenty years ago, your father pulled me onto the boat.

dialogue.speaker: jun
dialogue.zh: ……所以我才想再看看这座灯塔。
dialogue.en: ...That's why I wanted to see this lighthouse again.

dialogue.speaker: jun
dialogue.zh: 报告我会重写。这个港口，不该拆。
dialogue.en: I'll rewrite the report. This harbor shouldn't be torn down.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.zh: 这才是我记得的海风港。
dialogue.en: Now this is the Breezeport I remember.

setting.zh: 海风港——一座被遗忘的海边小港
